scope:
Static metric/provider geometry for larger cuts and loop radii.

No tail is recalibrated, no DN entry is reused, and no resonance or nonlinear
BVP is solved. The cut slope and second derivative use the prescribed tail
cut identities wCut and -7*wCut/rCut. Reported curvature and dimensions are
background surface-of-revolution samples; they are not the flexible image.

derivative_identity.fixed_outer_domain: Requires loop_radius < 0.385; not admissible for the requested .50/.60 inner radii.
derivative_identity.scope: Exact prefix background height derivative with all other profile controls fixed. Terminal bridge varies separately.

spherical_envelope.scope: The meridian is unit speed, so the norm is 1-Lipschitz and the sample-to-continuum diameter pad is max(ds). Numerical provider integration is not interval enclosed. Tail and cap are still separate.

remaining_envelope_budget.tail_and_cap_height_above_cut: B >= 0, to be recomputed for the new tail and cap
